0022600215.text: The Sacramento Kings (1-9, 0-5 at home, on a three-game losing streak) host the Orlando Magic (2-7, on a four-game losing streak and 2-3 on the road) in Sacramento's 11th game of the season, with the Kings 14th in the West and Orlando 12th in the East. Domantas Sabonis is day-to-day with knee soreness and a game-time decision, while Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery) and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated) are out for Sacramento. Orlando is without Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery) and Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and the teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season after Sacramento lost both games to Orlando in the 2025-26 season, most recently 121-117 in Orlando on March 26.
